propositions: Pydantic AI v2 defaults to Responses API for openai: prefix, but rebar pins openai-chat: explicitly and must prove compatibility before migrating deliberately.

Four production-construction constraints block openai-responses: usage in rebar today: KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES lacks the prefix, is_resolvable returns False due to missing known_model_names entries, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS has no openai-responses key, and openai:→openai-chat: normalizers hard-code the Chat pin.

Contract tests in test_openai_responses_contract.py use real pydantic-ai model construction (not mocks) with httpx.MockTransport stub to verify structured output, streaming, tool calls, retry behavior, and custom-base-URL routing under both openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes.

Capability matrix classifies 9 rows of rebar's OpenAI-compatible surface: hosted OpenAI is Responses-ready (pydantic-ai layer) and rebar-blocked by constraints; custom base_url, per-candidate endpoint, gateway/openai, and vendor qualifiers (deepseek, grok, xai, groq, cerebras, moonshotai, heroku) are Chat-Completions-only or UNKNOWN under the pinned 1.107.2 toolchain.
All 12 parameterized test cases pass identically under both openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes, with the parametrize ids serving as the behavioral-diff instrument for the migration.
